420:t_004:18.en:
$$リジット$$
「But the people of the fleet live by helping each other. Without a single exception.」

420:t_004:19.en:
$$オルダム$$
「Of course, there are quarrels and friction. But there is no true hatred in them.」

420:t_004:20.en:
$$桂$$
「I see. Sort of like one big family, then.」

420:t_004:21.en:
$$カレン$$
「So they fight sometimes, but they never hate each other. Is that it?」

420:t_004:22.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Impossible... Impossible! There can't be people like that!!」

420:t_004:23.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$. A man who forces the situation and his opponent into his own assumptions is not fit to be a commander.」

420:t_004:24.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You lost because you believed that everyone lives in hatred, just as you do.」

420:t_004:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「I don't mean to say that hatred is evil. It is one of the elements that shape a human being, too.」

420:t_004:26.en:
$$シン$$
「But there are people in this world who don't have it, and people who have gone beyond it!」

420:t_004:28.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your trump card has been broken, and yet you don't seem inclined to fall back.」

420:t_004:29.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I have a reason I cannot retreat!」

420:t_004:30.en:
$$葵$$
「Those words... I'll believe them, $$ギルター$$.」

420:t_004:31.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'm settling this once and for all today!」

420:t_005:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Our target is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! We'll hit him here and sweep the $$サイデリアル$$ out of the $$残されの海$$!」

420:t_005:1.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「As expected of the new Empress of the Sea... A fine piece of command.」

420:t_005:2.en:
$$レド$$
「To keep them from laying a hand on the fleet ever again, I'll hit them thoroughly!」

420:t_005:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit fully agrees.」

420:t_006:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Our target is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$! We'll hit him here and sweep the $$サイデリアル$$ out of the $$残されの海$$!」

420:t_006:1.en:
$$レド$$
「To keep them from laying a hand on the fleet ever again, I'll hit them thoroughly!」

420:t_006:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit fully agrees.」

420:t_007:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Me... losing in a place like this...!」

420:t_007:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「Know when you're beaten, $$ギルター$$!」

420:t_007:2.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Then I'll finish you off... for good!」

420:t_008:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you finally showed up, $$バルビエル$$!」

420:t_008:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What is this sorry state?」

420:t_008:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「For one who received the scorpion's poison from $$サルディアス$$, you don't seem to have achieved much.」

420:t_008:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-No... I mean...! P-Please forgive me, $$バルビエル$$!」

420:t_008:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Save your pathetic farce for later, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$!」

420:t_008:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you've come here, then I'll be your opponent!」

420:t_008:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...So you've noticed, it seems, $$セツコ$$.」

420:t_008:11.en:
$$シン$$
「What are you talking about, $$セツコ$$!?」

420:t_008:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「While $$ランド$$'s $$スフィア$$ is well matched with $$ストラウス$$'s $$スフィア$$...」

420:t_008:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア$$ is a poor match for mine.」

420:t_008:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「To completely defeat an awakened $$スフィア・リアクター$$, you need a $$スフィア$$ that's a poor match for theirs...」

420:t_008:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To defeat $$アイム・ライアード$$, the $$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アサキム$$ used the $$スフィア$$ of the $$知りたがる山羊$$.」

420:t_008:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「I see! So $$バルビエル$$ was thinking of dealing first with $$セツコ$$, who could beat him!」

420:t_008:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're a bigger coward than you look, $$バルビエル$$!」

420:t_008:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, second-rate Reactor. $$スフィア$$ compatibility means nothing in the face of overwhelming power.」

420:t_008:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And you're not the ones I have business with.」

420:t_008:22.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... I'll ask you one last time. Come with us.」

420:t_008:26.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So he's gone with the simplest way of using her.」

420:t_008:27.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If Miss $$スズネ$$ had come out onto the battlefield under mind control, there would still have been ways to deal with it, but...」

420:t_008:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There's nothing we can do like this...!」

420:t_008:31.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Crushed by despair, are you...? Then I'll give you hope.」

420:t_008:32.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「If you submit to us, I'll release $$西条涼音$$ and return the area you want to the Earth side.」

420:t_008:34.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Let's see... While I'm at it, I'll even return five people of your choice from among the humans we hold.」

420:t_008:35.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'd recommend the likes of $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$, $$ナナリー・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$, $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$ or $$マリナ・イスマイール$$.」

420:t_008:39.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now choose, $n. Hope for the future, or irreversible despair.」

420:t_009:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...A failure, then. He turned out less useful than I expected.」

420:t_009:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「You bastard, what did you do to $n!?」

420:t_009:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「He was drawing out the power of the $$スフィア$$ from within the conflicting emotions of hope and despair...」

420:t_009:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So I fed both of them. ...As a result, he couldn't choose either one, and his mind died, though.」
